name: TransactionLogTailing
summary: Publishes the messages an outbox holds by reading the database's own transaction log, so that every committed row reaches the broker and nothing else has to be asked.

roles.name: TransactionLogTailing
roles.summary: Reads the log the database already writes — the MySQL binlog, the Postgres write-ahead log, a DynamoDB stream — and publishes each message committed to the outbox. Accurate by construction and tied to one database engine by the same construction, so it is the participant a migration discovers late.
